result.rationale: The migration inserts raw site_setting values verbatim via SQL (`INSERT INTO embeddable_hosts (host, ...) VALUES ('#{h}', ...)`), bypassing the model's `before_validation` normalization that strips `https?://` and paths. Meanwhile `EmbeddableHost.record_for_host` matches with `where("lower(host) = ?", host)` against `uri.host`, so legacy entries like 'http://discourse.org' or 'https://example.com/1234' (which existed per the old spec tests) never match after upgrade, breaking embedding. Verifiable directly from the diff.

adjudication.rationale: In db/migrate/20150818190757_create_embeddable_hosts.rb the migration copies each line from the old `site_settings` value into `embeddable_hosts.host` via raw SQL (`VALUES ('#{h}', ...)`) without applying the `EmbeddableHost` model’s `before_validation` normalization that strips `http(s)://` and paths. Later, `EmbeddableHost.record_for_host` parses the referer/embed URL and compares `where("lower(host) = ?", uri.host)`, which will not match legacy entries stored as e.g. `http://discourse.org` or `https://example.com/1234`. The old `SiteSetting.allows_embeddable_host?` explicitly handled such variants, so upgrading could silently break embedding for existing non-normalized settings.
